response.rationale: R3 is the champion because it has the most specific ECG findings (inferior ST-segment elevation) and family history (sudden cardiac death at a young age) that are characteristic of Brugada Syndrome. R2 is the runner-up because it also has some supportive ECG findings and family history, but the diagnosis of CPVT is less specific and the ECG findings are not as typical. R1 is rejected because the ECG findings do not support Long QT Syndrome.
